# Remote Control Agent v0.1.37

This reviewed three-platform candidate delivers the Agent implementation of [Spec #539](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/issues/539) through the existing Remote Control tool surface. Public command and file API parameters remain unchanged.

- On verified Linux/ext filesystems in owner-private directories, newly created files are staged with restrictive permissions and linked exclusively into place after content preparation, reducing partially visible new files.
- Existing files, symlinks, hardlinks, Windows filesystem paths and other unverified cases preserve the prior in-place rewrite semantics, including the acknowledged interruption/partial-write risk. `write_file(append)` is unchanged.
- `replace_text` retains exact-match and UTF-8 validation with best-effort source-change detection. This is not cross-process compare-and-swap and does not guarantee crash-durable writes.
- Explicit `EEXIST` from staged exclusive link is reported as a definite no-target-effect failure; other uncertain outcomes remain protected by the existing SQLite operation receipts and must not be blindly replayed. Temporary-file cleanup failures emit a fixed non-sensitive diagnostic without changing confirmed write receipts.
- No device re-pair, privilege expansion, Worker auto-deployment, newly persistent service or new GitHub Actions pipeline.

The independent security review of the narrow Agent follow-up [PR #71](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/71) was **Waived by Owner**; a single-context source review and three-platform CI were completed. Source-merge and candidate CI are not proof of installed-device production acceptance. An independent Worker release/pin update and separately verified device upgrades are needed before claiming end-to-end completion.
